messages.subject: [IT] Document management system maintenance - Saturday 17 August
messages.plaintextBody:
All,

The DMS (iManage) will be unavailable from 22:00 Saturday 17 August to 04:00 Sunday for scheduled maintenance. Please check in any open documents before 21:00. Email is unaffected.

IT Helpdesk
